identity.original_title: 东方醉游稽传~Touhou Drunken Rebellion

hooks.text: 弱小妖怪以酒吧为据点成立改革组织，发起自下而上的幻想乡叛乱
hooks.excerpt: They form the Youkai Reform Organization , using a lively youkai bar as their base of operations, recruiting like-minded allies from far and wide. In this glorious rebellion from below, they swear to reclaim the justice that belongs to them!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不同弹幕各有战术用途，可装配到武器上重组火力模式
hooks.excerpt: Every type of danmaku has its own unique purpose. Equip them onto your weapons and unleash your frepower in the most spectacular way possible!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 根据战况搭配酒类被动、角色特性和弹幕，喝出强力联动
hooks.excerpt: The game features a wide variety of drinks, each providing diferent passive efects. Choosing the right drinks, character passives, and danmaku for each situation is one of the keys to becoming truly powerful.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
